verdict.rationale: The Agent Skills spec says agents load only each installed skill's name and description at startup, "just enough to know when it might be relevant" (docs-3, docs-12). skills.sh installs SKILL.md files into each agent's skills directory where that discovery happens (gh-24, gh-29, docs-16), and a hands-on probe showed every listed skill carries a full trigger description (probe-rt-2). However, the activation itself is performed by the host agent, not by skills.sh, and the evidence never shows how descriptions are crafted for accurate triggering. missing for 10: guidance or tooling for writing descriptions that trigger reliably (beyond a bare `skills init` template), hands-on evidence that installed skills actually auto-activate at the right moment, independent corroboration of trigger accuracy.
